between_attempt_learning: Conserve ammo; tap visible coil and fire shorter bursts during cyan exposed windows; defend during route travel.

helpful_moments.observation: Handbook fits portrait and explains tap aim, FIRE drag, ROUTE and coil colors
Planning map shows route line, walking distance, receiver checkmarks and extraction selection; it stays paused until CLOSE MAP
Receiver SAVED cue plus health/shield/ammo refill made recovery tangible
Coil HUD explicitly switches from percentage to OFF, then objective changes to RETURN TO DECK
Loss menu clearly separates RETRY FROM UPLINK from START FRESH and reports assist usage

frustrating_moments.observation: Long FIRE holds spent ammo rapidly while armor blocked useful progress; first attempt became an empty-ammo supply search
Directional threat text helped identify danger but did not make offscreen attackers easy to engage while routing
Positioning combined with tap aim was manageable when centered, but a short strafe lost the third coil entirely; my subsequent marker-directed burst was an operator error
Fine HUD labels, compass numbers and terminal assist summary are small at 390px; dark architecture can reduce target separation

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but workable with substantial friction, 7 good with clear rough edges, 10 exceptional throughout assessed content. Scores reflect observed interaction and presentation, not win/loss, completion speed or unassessed enjoyment.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, attractive mission made accessible by route assistance, tap aim and planning, offset by narrow-view combat awareness, ammo friction and positioning difficulty. Paused emulation limits confidence.
reasons.controls: Large separated action targets and two-contact route/fire work. Manual movement plus aiming lost target context; no claim about physical thumb comfort or responsiveness.
reasons.gameplay: Receiver recovery, resource replenishment and three timed coil targets provide understandable progression; offscreen pressure and empty-ammo recovery were frustrating. Short-burst strategy improved agency. Upload defense not sufficiently observed to grade.
reasons.presentation: Distinct teal/amber visual language, rainy industrial setting, consistent typography and polished result cards. Audio and hardware frame pacing unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, map, fresh-run choice and explicit objectives help. Running out of ammo gave guidance but locating supplies remained unresolved; assisted route travel can obscure spatial learning.
reasons.readability: Main objectives, large resource counts, receiver names and map route readable in portrait. Small status/summary text and dark target surroundings demand closer inspection.

protocol_caveat: All screenshots were opened with view_image. However, many early image-view calls and their following adaptive input were submitted in the same orchestration call, so those inputs were selected before the newly returned image could be inspected. This does not fully satisfy the requested view-before-adaptive-input order. Later coil/deck steps separated viewing from input. Wrong marker-directed burst is preserved; no strict protocol certification is claimed.

cleanup.outcome: Exact owned driver and Chrome PIDs absent; no kill commands used.
